title: Spark Notebook Quicklaunch — model picker & request composer screenshots
creator: Aisha Park
description: Produce a focused, captioned asset bundle for the Spark Notebook Quicklaunch flow: model selection, request composer (with presets), and three code-snippet variants (Python, Node, curl). These assets will be used in docs, the console quickstart modal, and marketing one-pagers. The scope covers responsive screenshots (desktop/tablet/mobile), annotated callouts for primary affordances (model picker, streaming toggle, temperature slider, request preview), and short code tiles that map directly to the UI state shown in the images.
acceptance_criteria: High-res desktop screenshot of model picker (expanded) with model metadata hover visible
Request composer screenshot showing a prefilled prompt, streaming toggled on, and token estimate badge
Three code snippet tiles (Python, Node, curl) that reflect the exact request payload visible in the UI screenshot
All images exported in light and dark themes and available in 2x and 3x sizes for responsive docs
review_feedback: PM (Leah Kim): align label copy with console glossary; change 'Streaming' to 'Stream responses' for clarity
Eng (Karan Singh): confirm token-estimate calc matches runtime metric; flagged a mismatch in the badge rounding -> engineered PR ENG-58211
Docs (Ravi Patel): prefer inline code examples limited to 6 lines; added suggestion to include one minimal example and one expanded example
Design Lead (Mina Cho): reduce visual noise around model performance hints; prefer 60% opacity background for hint chips
links: Engineering ticket for token estimate sync: ENG-58211
